apps/web/components/features/admin/admin.error: The drawer renders a user row its parent already loaded and never fetches; the detector matched the copy-failure toast toast.error(`Failed to copy ${label}`), which the certificate test covers.
apps/web/components/features/admin/admin.permission-denied: The drawer has no role or permission check (the admin route guards it); the detector matched the billing plan badge user.plan.

apps/web/components/features/admin/agent.loading: The drawer renders an artifact its parent already holds (or null for no selection) and never fetches; the detector matched the human-gate label key pending: 'Pending'.
apps/web/components/features/admin/agent.offline: The drawer neither fetches nor mutates; it only renders the passed artifact and its outbound links. The offline flag came from the pending: 'Pending' label match.

apps/web/components/features/admin/agent.empty: The row renders exactly one artifact and owns no collection; the detector matched the items-start and items-center classes.
apps/web/components/features/admin/agent.loading: The row renders an artifact its parent already holds and never fetches; the detector matched the human-gate label key pending: 'Review Required'.
apps/web/components/features/admin/agent.offline: The row neither fetches nor mutates; its only handler is onSelect(artifact). The offline flag came from the pending: 'Review Required' label match.

apps/web/components/features/admin/certi.long-content: The glyphs are fixed-size SVG icons whose only text is a fixed state or tier label in aria-label and <title>; no caller-supplied copy can grow them.
apps/web/components/features/admin/certi.offline: The glyphs are pure SVG with no fetch or mutation; the offline flag came from the pending: 'Pending' evidence-status key.
apps/web/components/features/admin/certi.permission-denied: The glyphs gate nothing; the detector matched role='img' on each SVG. Evidence and approval states are covered by the State, StateMatrix and EvidenceMatrix stories.

The workspace has no role or permission check of its own (the admin route guards it); the detector matched role='toolbar' on the state filter bar. A 403 decision reason is rendered by CertificationDetailRail through decisionError.

apps/web/components/features/admin/decis.permission-denied: The card has no role or permission check; the detector matched role='status' and role='alert' on the outcome and error lines. A source with no reject path is shown by PartialNoRejectPath, and a refused write by the Error story.

apps/web/components/features/admin/feedb.long-content: The registry emits two fixed labels, 'Copy As Markdown' and 'Dismiss'; no caller copy reaches the rendered actions, so there is no long content to wrap.
apps/web/components/features/admin/feedb.offline: The registry only builds action definitions and calls the caller's handlers; it never fetches. The offline flag came from the status union 'pending' | 'dismissed'; an in-flight dismiss is the LoadingDismissPending story.

apps/web/components/features/admin/hud/H.permission-denied: The card only ranks bottlenecks from metrics its parent already loaded and has no gated action or role check; the detector matched the list semantics role='listitem' on each row.
